data.title: About the Department
description: The Department of Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology), established in 2024 at Karpagam College of Engineering in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research, and industry collaboration in the field of VLSI.

content: The department focuses on the core areas of VLSI system design, verification, and testing—key components in the development of modern integrated circuits (IC) used across a wide range of electronic devices. Our goal is to provide students with a strong foundation in VLSI technologies, covering the complete design cycle from concept to final implementation.

The B.E. in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology) program offers a balanced blend of theoretical knowledge and practical expertise. The curriculum is industry-oriented and supported by state-of-the-art laboratories, enabling students to gain hands-on experience in electronics fundamentals, advanced VLSI design techniques, and modern testing methodologies.

Students are trained using industry-standard Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools and are encouraged to solve real-world engineering problems. The department also emphasizes critical thinking, innovation, and professional ethics to prepare students for successful careers in the semiconductor industry.
With a strong commitment to quality education and skill development, the department aims to shape future-ready engineers in the rapidly evolving field of VLSI Design and Technology.

content.title: Our Vision
content.description: To excel as a sophisticated and contributive department in fulfilling the academic and research requirements of VLSI Design and Technology

item: By facilitating effective teaching learning methods with adequate VLSI industry interaction for promoting learner’s global competency.
By fostering collaborative research and innovation activities for addressing industrial challenges.
By inculcating values and ethics among learners for sustainable development .

content.description: Graduates of the program will exhibit professional expertise in analog and digital VLSI design and other associated disciplines.
Graduates of the program will engage in research pursuits in VLSI system design and its associated fields, with a sense of ethics and social responsibility.
Graduates of the program will deliver effective solutions to Microelectronics system design challenges as professionals committed to life-long learning.

content.title: Engineering Knowledge
content.description: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.

content.title: Problem Analysis
content.description: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4)

content.title: Design/Development of Solutions
content.description: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5)

content.title: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems
content.description: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis and interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8)

content.title: Engineering Tool Usage
content.description: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6)

content.title: The Engineer and The World
content.description: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5, and WK7)

content.title: Ethics
content.description: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national and international laws. (WK9)

content.title: Individual and Collaborative Team Work
content.description: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse and multi-disciplinary teams.

content.title: Communication
content.description: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences.

content.title: Project Management and Finance
content.description: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

content.title: Life-Long Learning
content.description: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for independent and life-long learning, adaptability to new and emerging technologies and critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8)
Design and test efficient VLSI circuits and systems with optimized power utility.
Design microelectronics systems and components for contemporary industrial applications to perform analog and digital processing and computational functions.

text: Dr. A. Rajendran is currently serving as Professor and Head of the Department of Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) at Karpagam College of Engineering, Coimbatore.

He completed his B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Kongu Engineering College, Erode, in 1996. He later earned his M.S. (By Research) in Information and Communication Engineering from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, in 2007, followed by a Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, in 2013.

With an extensive academic career spanning 29 years, including 8 years dedicated to research, Dr. Rajendran has held various key academic and administrative positions. His areas of expertise include VLSI Design, VLSI Signal Processing, and Wireless Communication.

He has successfully guided 5 Ph.D. scholars under Anna University and has published over 90 research papers in reputed national and international journals and conferences. He also serves as an active reviewer for leading publishers such as Springer and Elsevier.

Dr. Rajendran has received funding from AICTE for organizing Faculty Development Programs (FDPs) and has significant experience in accreditation processes, including NBA and NAAC, as well as Outcome-Based Education (OBE) practices.

The Department of Electronics Engineering [VLSI Design and Technology] at KCE has distinguished faculty with strong expertise. Combining research, industry exposure and dynamic teaching, they shape graduates who can make an impact in modern technologies.
